stem: Mr. Okafor is the only finalist ______ résumé lists both warehouse automation and customs compliance, and the panel has therefore placed him first on its shortlist.

The Brightwater hangar, ______, despite its age and its cramped doors, still handles every overnight engine check for the airline's regional fleet, is scheduled to be replaced by a larger facility in 2028.

The ferry operator announced that vehicle crossings would be suspended until the damaged ramp had been repaired, ______ in turn forced three island hotels to cancel their weekend bookings and, in one case, close early for the season.
The credit committee approved ______ the external auditors, after reviewing three years of loan files, had recommended, and the risk department was asked to report on progress every quarter.
The translator ______ the publisher has, over the past nine years, collaborated on every title in its Nordic crime series is retiring, and the search for a successor has begun.
In situations ______ a supplier cannot, for reasons beyond its control, deliver within the agreed period, the buyer may extend the deadline once without penalty or cancel the order.

The sanitation department's annual compliance audit, ______ the inspectors interviewed, one by one, more than sixty drivers and reviewed two years of maintenance logs, found no safety violations at any of the four depots.
The university operates three satellite campuses, ______ combined enrollment has doubled since 2018 and now exceeds that of the main campus.
The staffing agency placed forty temporary nurses at the Eastgate clinic during the flu season, ______ had previously worked in intensive care and were able to start without additional orientation.
The museum's board received three proposals to redesign the east gallery, ______ met the budget ceiling that the finance committee had set at its meeting in March.
Claims under the extended warranty must be filed within thirty days of the purchase date or of the date on which the fault was first detected, ______ is later, and must include proof of purchase.
Front desk agents are free to offer guests ______ they judge will resolve a complaint, from a room upgrade to a complimentary dinner, without first consulting a duty manager.
Any supporting documents ______ with the court registry after the filing deadline will be returned unopened, and the claimant will be notified of the rejection in writing.
Technicians ______ the quarterly calibration of the extruders at the Eastfield plant, most of them with more than a decade of experience, have been reporting the same fault since January.
The festival director, ______, after eleven years with the city's tourism board, now oversees every stage of the program, has asked the volunteers to arrive an hour early on the opening day.
The distribution center ______ the retailer, after two years of planning, commissioned in the northern region last spring has already doubled the number of orders it can process each day.
The clinic thanked the three outside consultants ______ the trial protocol, together with its consent forms and safety rules, had been drafted over the course of the previous year.
______ the sales team needs most from the new reporting tool is not more charts but faster access to the weekly figures that regional managers request.
